rows.grounds: compound beginning with naivedya; object of offering implied by ritual context
locative indicating the concluding phase of worship
addressed agents responsible for the ritual act

items.question: What offerings are due to Caṇḍeśa at the conclusion of worship by the best priests?
premises: The worship sequence includes a concluding phase.
Food offerings and related items are designated for that concluding phase.
The best priests are the agents responsible for presenting offerings to Caṇḍeśa.
items.inference: Therefore the best priests must present the food offering and related items to Caṇḍeśa at the end of worship.
uncertainties: The specific items included under naivedyādyaṃ beyond food offering are not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: O best priests, at the end of the worship present the food offering and so forth to Caṇḍeśa.
